integrity: Proof is self-contained apart from standard independent-variable Poisson point-process and point-process continuous mapping theorems. Numerical tests do not establish asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive power exponent; no quantitative rate or uniform regime near exponent zero. Marginal Gumbel laws are known; claimed refinement is marked endpoint-index localization.
title: Marked Zipf coupon extremes: independent Gumbel completion time and exponential terminal rank
